book.name: Talfut Kese
book.title: Sunbin-Got em Abiil so Kawin so Talfut Kelewse Sang te.

content: Keko beli, Sunbin-Got e gung kel ding aulbabelei, abiil so, kawin so, beem mesesem eisneng fok ke kolewse kale. Fok kolewsomi, ben kel ding kabalak e, e akalem alubamin alik alik be banim keleweko, finengdase kale.

Finengdase kasike, Sunbin-Got e ben em ding em dim beelo akalem ding kuw dukuko, tokotoko ayem ding kelewse kale. Nimtew angom? Gung kel em ding be, e alik alik mesesem mesesem eisneng bi kilele duku kolewse kasike.
Sang be Yawe Sunbin-Got em kawin so abiil so talfut dukuse sang bete te.
Sunbin-Got em Kunum Waneng ilo Kilke Dukuse em Sang te.
Kate itel so, ais mesesem mesesem so, alik alik eisneng bi tebelinba kesiliw ding kabalak e, suuk akal banimei, kawin musun kailomin kunum mak akal banimse kale.
Beem ding dim kabalak e, ok e yukam misin atew kawin katiw somelei, kawin elo ok dukalewale kale.
Keko beli, Yawe Sunbin-Got e tawal dak fakalat kelewko, kawin be amiami kelewsomelei, kunum mak keleweko, em mutum tem kel akalem fukfuka fu kelei, kunum be finik so kese kale. Kunum be Adam
te.
Keko beli, e ataan tele dulum kalote ken musun mak dukusomi, kunum beelo debeleko, elo ka kel kolewse kale. Kolewse musun beem wiin e Iden te.

Beli, musun dim ka kel e ais banban mak talfut kelewsomi, ais ati so ati so em dim e wanin dem so dem so ken kuw dukuse kale. Dukusomi, musun ka kel beem mutuk kabalak e ais alew mak dukuse kale. Ais alew bi mak e, finik so bin duyembin em ais te. Mak e, wa so ken so elo fitew dalomin em ais te.

Keko beli, musun Iden ka e, ok malmil miktem telebin ok mak alenale kale. Ok malmil miktem telebe ok be musun em kawin elo ok dulew ke alenale kale. Kebomelei, ok be teing titeleko, ketket teben aneng aneng elo kese kale.
Emisik ok em wiin e Bison te. E gol on kisol so eisneng Kawila aneng fian beem dulum elo falalse kale.
Gol on kisol be ken ati kuw te. On kisol eisneng makso mak alenale te. Mak e, filik falak tum win “Kanilian” e, mak e, kamge so ais gom mak te.
Beli, mak emteben ok em wiin e Gikon. Gikon ok bang e Kus aneng elo falal kolewse kale.
Yemamas ok beem wiin e Taigilis. Ok be anko, ataan tele beem dulum Asilia aneng fian kalo kese kale. Ok fefe beem wiin e Yufeletis.
Keko beli, Yawe Sunbin-Got e kunum beelo bokolewomele: “Ku musun Iden elo kilelbi atebolewka!”, dangeko, elo duku kolewsomelei,
iti weng makso mak bokolewomele: “Alik alik ais angom beem ais dem be ken kuw kelei, ku fein wanbolewka!
Kate, ku kanelom ais ken so wa so kal kemin ais beem dem wanokolew te! Wanew tewe, ku fongate akate atin kuw kuanokolew te.”, dangse kale.
Dangeko beli, anfel e Yawe Sunbin-Got e bokolomele: “Adam be emikel kuw be kasike, ken bate. Kame, ne elo dokoleweko, eso fangfang dakamin akalem atew mak dulewoki te.”, angse kale.

Angesomelei, Yawe Sunbin-Got e tawal kuluko, mesesem mesesem samal so, abiil awon so, alik alik eisneng angom be amiami duku koyemsomi, ilo kunum beem mit mewso koyemse kale. Koyemsomelei, kunum be alik alik ilo diw yetebomelei, ikalem wiin amen kuw amen kuw bokoyemse kale.

Keko beli, kunum be mesesem mesesem kut samal bi so, am samal bi so, abiil em awon bi so, alik alik finik so bin biim wiin amen kuw amen kuw bokoyemse kate, fangfang dakamin akalem atew mak banim kese kale.
Beli, Yawe Sunbin-Got e Adam elo kuanin atew kiin ok ilum fian mak dulewsomi, em melen kun makmak takas kuluko, tem be iti talewse kale.
Taleweko, melen kun be kuluko, waneng mak kaiko, ulo kunum be so koumse kale.
Koumeko, kunum be waneng buulo watemeko, bokolomele: “Kae, Yawe nakalem kun, nakalem dim kuluko, waneng bute dukunemse kasike, um wiin e waneng
te.”, angse kale.
Beem mongom ete kame akal, kunum kumel i ikalem aliwol kumel so auk kumel so koyem uneko, ikalem kalel kusel iso teinsomi, i kal anggil makmak kekabiliw te.
Kunum be so, waneng bu so, yemkal bi anggil fitew kesiliw kate, i finganinba kesiliw kale.

footnotes.text: 2:7 Kale, Suda im weng sin e weng be mongom so te. Ikalem weng sin e “Adam” beem mongom ete ‘Kunum Waneng Makmak’. Ikalem weng sin e “Adama” beem mongom ete ‘Kawin’. Kasike, Sunbin-Got e “Adama” kulusomelei, “Adam” mak amiami kelewse kale.
2:23 Suda im weng sin e kunum ilo “is” yangomi, waneng ilo “isa” yangenkabiliw te. Weng alew bi ki ki akate tew kelaka.
